announcement_season_competition_check.name: announcement_season_competition_check
announcement_season_competition_check.value: "announcements"."season_id" is null or "announcements"."competition_id" is not null

disciplinary_case_subject_check.name: disciplinary_case_subject_check
disciplinary_case_subject_check.value: "disciplinary_cases"."subject_type" in ('player','team','official','match','other') and ("disciplinary_cases"."subject_player_registration_id" is not null or "disciplinary_cases"."subject_user_id" is not null or "disciplinary_cases"."subject_team_registration_id" is not null or "disciplinary_cases"."origin_match_id" is not null)

disciplinary_case_closure_check.name: disciplinary_case_closure_check
disciplinary_case_closure_check.value: "disciplinary_cases"."status" <> 'closed' or ("disciplinary_cases"."closed_at" is not null and "disciplinary_cases"."closure_reason" is not null)

disciplinary_sanction_dates_check.name: disciplinary_sanction_dates_check
disciplinary_sanction_dates_check.value: "disciplinary_sanctions"."ends_at" is null or "disciplinary_sanctions"."starts_at" is null or "disciplinary_sanctions"."ends_at" >= "disciplinary_sanctions"."starts_at"

disciplinary_sanction_scope_check.name: disciplinary_sanction_scope_check
disciplinary_sanction_scope_check.value: ("disciplinary_sanctions"."sanction_type" not in ('match_suspension','competition_suspension')) or ("disciplinary_sanctions"."matches_count" is not null or "disciplinary_sanctions"."ends_at" is not null)

dispute_decision_check.name: dispute_decision_check
dispute_decision_check.value: "disputes"."status" not in ('decided','closed') or "disputes"."decision" is not null

dispute_closure_check.name: dispute_closure_check
dispute_closure_check.value: "disputes"."status" <> 'closed' or ("disputes"."closed_at" is not null and "disputes"."closure_reason" is not null)

evidence_target_check.name: evidence_target_check
evidence_target_check.value: ("evidence_files"."case_id" is not null and "evidence_files"."dispute_id" is null) or ("evidence_files"."case_id" is null and "evidence_files"."dispute_id" is not null)

evidence_removal_check.name: evidence_removal_check
evidence_removal_check.value: ("evidence_files"."removed_at" is null and "evidence_files"."removed_by" is null) or ("evidence_files"."removed_at" is not null and "evidence_files"."removed_by" is not null)

lineup_player_coordinates_check.name: lineup_player_coordinates_check
lineup_player_coordinates_check.value: (("lineup_players"."x" is null and "lineup_players"."y" is null) or ("lineup_players"."x" is not null and "lineup_players"."y" is not null and "lineup_players"."x" between 0 and 100 and "lineup_players"."y" between 0 and 100))

lineup_formation_check.name: lineup_formation_check
lineup_formation_check.value: "lineups"."formation" is null or case when "lineups"."formation" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*(-[1-9][0-9]*)+$' then touchline_formation_outfield_count("lineups"."formation") = 10 else false end

match_event_distinct_players_check.name: match_event_distinct_players_check
match_event_distinct_players_check.value: "match_events"."player_registration_id" is null or "match_events"."secondary_player_registration_id" is null or "match_events"."player_registration_id" <> "match_events"."secondary_player_registration_id"

match_event_substitution_players_check.name: match_event_substitution_players_check
match_event_substitution_players_check.value: "match_events"."event_type" <> 'substitution' or ("match_events"."player_registration_id" is not null and "match_events"."secondary_player_registration_id" is not null)

match_times_check.name: match_times_check
match_times_check.value: "matches"."started_at" is null or "matches"."ended_at" is null or "matches"."ended_at" >= "matches"."started_at"

season_dates_check.name: season_dates_check
season_dates_check.value: "seasons"."ends_on" is null or "seasons"."starts_on" is null or "seasons"."ends_on" >= "seasons"."starts_on"

users_suspension_check.name: users_suspension_check
users_suspension_check.value: ("users"."suspended_at" is null and "users"."suspended_reason" is null and "users"."suspended_by" is null) or ("users"."suspended_at" is not null and "users"."suspended_reason" is not null)
